summary: Pin spec/'s dotted cites into public types against src/ declarations — the symbol half of the spec-lint pin

per.section: What holds this page above prose

pins: every dotted spec cite whose prefix is a public type resolves on its last segment to a declaration in src/
the spec symbol scan reads every page of spec/
the symbol needle flags an injected stale member cite and leaves the not-exist sentences the allowlist declares
acceptance: The scan's symbol half runs green over spec/ as it stands, with its subject, its allowlist and its sensitivity driven both ways.
notes: Subject ruled by the operator: a backticked dotted token whose prefix is a type the page's *Public surface* bullet names (the eight, plus src/index.ts exports), resolved on its last segment. No non-symbol vocabulary. Declared allowlist for the sentences naming a symbol to say it does not exist — DispatcherOptions.trunkBranch, Chain.harvest, Chain.worktreesDir. Measured green at bbc39b2.

edit.description: a tests/ root on the spec locator scan, beside the src/ and path:NN needles

summary: Pin spec/ against test cites — a flat refusal on tests/ paths, with the empty case asserted explicitly

per.section: A claim names behavior, never location

pins: no spec page cites a path under tests/
the test-cite needle flags an injected tests/ path and leaves the bin/, scripts/ and examples/ cites the corpus writes
acceptance: The clause refusing a test title or fixture has a needle, green over a corpus with zero sites and driven both ways.
notes: The three tests/ cites the path pin left behind went at bbc39b2, so this is a flat refusal over an empty set — spell the empty case, never inherit it. Scope is tests/ alone: the bin/, scripts/ and examples/ cites in cli.md, pending.md and chain.md are claim subjects, and the page refuses neither.
